dedupe_keys.name: ebu technical report tr 024 sfn frequency planning and network implementation for t dab and dvb t

description: EBU Technical Report TR 24 is a guide on frequency planning and network implementation of single frequency networks (SFN) with regard to T-DAB and DVB-T. The October 2013 edition supersedes BPN 066 of July 2005 and covers the technical elements of the broadcast transmission channel, OFDM features, multipath capability, inter-symbol interference and guard interval, FFT-window synchronisation strategies (strongest signal, first signal above a threshold, centre of gravity, quasi-optimal) and the planning of SFN coverage and networks. Producer: the European Broadcasting Union's Technical Department in Geneva. Coverage: European digital radio and television broadcasting, with methods that apply to any OFDM broadcast network. Access: a free 135-page PDF on the EBU technology site. Licence and cost: free to download; no licence text was seen in the pages read. Caveats: written in 2005 and revised in 2013, it predates DVB-T2 and later systems, and it is a planning guide, not a dataset. Simulation uses: the guard interval, self-interference and synchronisation rules are the basis of SFN coverage and capacity models for terrestrial broadcast networks. Related records: DVB specifications (data-dvb-specifications-bluebooks) and the DVB-T2 specification (data-dvb-t2-specification-etsi).
